title: tephroseris reverdattoi
intro: Tephroseris reverdattoi, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The plant is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Everlasting include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities, which may help in wound healing and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Tephroseris reverdattoi include sesquiterpenes and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
